layout.title: Import transactions
layout.description: A bank CSV statement goes into a wallet: duplicates are skipped, payees and envelopes are matched by rules.

date.label: Date
date.hint: The first one present in the list.

amount.label: Amount
amount.hint: Signed amount. Without it — debit and credit.

debit.label: Debit
debit.hint: Expenses in a separate column (sign ignored).

payee.label: Payee
payee.hint: The first non-empty value in the row.

memo.label: Memo
memo.hint: All columns from the list, joined.

external_id.label: Transaction ID
external_id.hint: Without it, duplicates are recognised by a hash of the date, amount and memo.

currency.label: Currency
currency.hint: Different from the wallet's currency — a row error.

state.label: State
state.hint: With the “Imported states” list, skips e.g. pending operations.

fileProblem.empty: The file is empty — choose a statement with transactions.
fileProblem.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MiB. Export a shorter period and import it in parts.

parser.formLabel: Adjust how the file is read
parser.dateFormatHint: E.g. DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Empty — as in preset.
parser.skipRowsHint: The header is looked for only after them.
parser.acceptStatesHint: With a “State” column: only these values, comma-separated. Empty — all.
parser.hasHeaderHint: Without a header, columns are given by number (1, 2, …).
parser.invertHint: When expenses in the file are positive (e.g. a credit card statement).
parser.columnsIntro: Each entry is a list of alternatives — the first one present in the file wins (payee: the first non-empty; memo: all joined).
parser.presetMissing: As in preset (not in the file)
parser.manualHint: {{hint}} Column names or numbers, comma-separated; empty — as in preset.

wizard.viewerBody: The “Viewer” role can browse import history but can't upload files. Ask the owner to change your role.
wizard.noWalletBody: Transactions from a statement go into one wallet — an account, a card or cash.
wizard.fileHeading: 1. Choose a wallet and a file
wizard.walletHint: Amounts in the file must be in the wallet's currency.
wizard.previewMeta: {{file}} → {{wallet}} · preset {{preset}}. Nothing has been saved yet.
wizard.optionErrorsTitle: Couldn't read the file with these settings
wizard.optionErrorsBody: Fix the highlighted fields in “Adjust” — e.g. point to the date and amount columns or change the separator.
wizard.nothingNewDuplicates: Nothing new to import — all operations are already in the wallet.
wizard.fileHint: A CSV history export from your bank, up to 5 MiB. Encoding and separator are detected automatically.
wizard.noneAdded: No new transactions added — all operations in the file were already in the wallet or had errors.
wizard.skippedBody: Error details are on the import page. Fix the file or the settings and import it again — operations already saved will be recognised as duplicates.

history.heading: Import history
history.intro: Each uploaded file is a batch — you can review and revert it. Newest first.
history.emptyBody: Upload a bank statement and the transactions will appear in the wallet without retyping.

batch.notFoundBody: The import doesn't exist or belongs to a wallet you can't see.
batch.revertedBody_one: Deleted {{count}} transaction. Importing the same file again will recreate it.
batch.revertedBody_other: Deleted {{count}} transactions. Importing the same file again will recreate them.
batch.confirmBody_one: We'll delete {{count}} transaction from this import (including any edited later). Subscription charges it paid will return to the matching queue.
batch.confirmBody_other: We'll delete {{count}} transactions from this import (including any edited later). Subscription charges they paid will return to the matching queue.
